article.hook: You believe anything is possible, even if the map is blank. Neptune in Sagittarius blurs borders between what’s real and what’s dreamed, urging a leap into the unknown without a parachute. It’s the rush of freedom with a splash of fog.
article.lived: For fourteen years, this transit stretches our days and years with restless wonder. We sign up for courses in languages we barely intend to finish, book trips without packing, and debate ideas that float off before landing. Plans grow wings, and optimism spills into conversations, making every new idea feel like the next big truth.
article.turn: When the horizon keeps moving farther away, you start chasing ghosts instead of goals. The same optimism that launched you now fuels distraction and confusion - turning grand visions into scattered commitments and endless detours. Clarity dies when everything feels like a promise, but nothing holds still enough to catch.
moves: Pick one bold idea and follow it through to the end, no matter how small the finish line.
Say yes to one invitation that scares you, then show up fully prepared to be surprised.
Write a letter to your future self about what freedom means, then read it once a year.
